Changed paths:

- `tests/acp-tools.test.mjs` — `stripDoneMarker` import + 3 new cases: unit coverage of inline/own-line/mid-text, e2e inline marker → final + stripped (no nudge), e2e mid-text marker → nudge path (lands in `agent_thought_chunk`, not the message)

Verification:

APPROACH: widened the marker regex from "whole last line" to "tail of the reply" — `([ \t]*\*{0,2}\[\[done\]\]\*{0,2})+[ \t]*$` — so `text [[done]]` and `**[[done]]**` at the end strip cleanly while mid-text `[[done]]` returns null and keeps the nudge semantics.

LESSON: a protocol marker that models tolerate "at the end" will appear inline as often as on its own line — anchoring the regex to end-of-reply once beats enumerating line-shape variants.
